name: Albescent-Inselberg

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws towering mountain ranges, patient as erosion itself.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
Whoever controls copper controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
